themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants in social aid, housing, and employment. This theme appears in Spain, Italy, Sweden, and Norway, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Sverigedemokraterna, and Fremskrittspartiet leading the charge. The framing often ties national identity to economic and social benefits, reflecting a broader transnational trend of policy imitation and shared rhetoric.

countries.note: Supports policies prioritizing Italian citizens in social housing and welfare programs.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Proposes nationwide headscarf ban and efficiency minister to cut public waste, targeting immigrant communities.

countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration controls and prioritizing Norwegian citizens in social services.

countries.note: Proposes 'Women and Motherhood Protection Act' with nationalist undertones, despite internal contradictions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Opposes EU migration pact, framing it as a threat to French sovereignty and national identity.

themes.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal dominates global discourse
themes.blurb: The U.S.-Iran peace deal, brokered under the Trump administration, has become a defining cross-national story, drawing reactions from right-wing parties in the U.S., Italy, France, Poland, and Spain. Coverage spans from supportive framing of the deal as a diplomatic victory to criticism of its terms and implications for regional stability. The theme reflects shared concerns about Middle East policy and its impact on global security.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Italy, Argentina, the UK, Hungary, and Spain are grappling with internal divisions over leadership, policy direction, and electoral strategy. These divisions often manifest in public spats, leadership challenges, and defections, reflecting broader tensions between radical and moderate factions within these movements. The theme highlights the fragility of far-right unity despite shared ideological goals.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei's declining approval ratings and internal strife within La Libertad Avanza have become a cross-national theme, resonating in the U.S., Italy, Spain, and Poland. Coverage focuses on Milei's confrontational leadership style, economic policies, and scandals involving key allies like Manuel Adorni. The theme reflects broader concerns about populist governance and its sustainability.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts

Coverage ranges from support for Israel to criticism of Western intervention, reflecting a shared concern about the region's impact on global stability and domestic politics. The theme highlights the far-right's transnational engagement with foreign policy issues.
